name: Folder Float
description: Small 3D folder that opens its flap and floats a cloud of pill-shaped notes above it. Pills drift with Matter.js physics, can be dragged and tapped to select.
contents: Folder graphic with back panel, tab, paper sheet and tilting front flap showing a label and sublabel
Pill buttons for each item that fan out above the folder
Invisible toggle button over the folder front
behavior: Opens on hover or on click depending on trigger, Escape closes
Flap tilts open and pills spring out with staggered timing on a row layout with slight jitter and tilt
After the open animation, Matter.js physics starts: pills drift gently, collide with each other and bounds, and can be dragged
Click or tap on a pill fires onSelect and plays a pop animation, optionally closing the folder
Respects prefers-reduced-motion by skipping physics and using fades
editableByProps: Folder label, sublabel and the list of pill items (strings or label/value objects)
All folder, flap, paper, pill and text colors
Folder size, corner radius, pill spread, lift and tilt, flap angles
Open trigger (hover or click), default open state, close on select
Physics on or off, drift strength, open duration, stagger and spring bounce

needsCodeEdit.change: Change pill height, font size or shadow
needsCodeEdit.where: className of the pill button inside list.map (h-[34px], rounded-[17px], shadow)

needsCodeEdit.change: Change pill collision feel (bounciness, air friction)
Change pill row spacing and wrapping
needsCodeEdit.where: PAD, CHAR, GAP, ROW constants and the layout function
'--ff-tab' value in the root style object

fixed: Pills are laid out above the folder, so leave free vertical space above it, since content there is overlapped
Pill width is estimated from characters until measured, then measured from the DOM
Root is an inline-block of the given width with no viewport frame, so it must be centered by the host
Pill text is single line with nowrap, long labels create wide pills
Hover trigger has no hover on touch, use trigger click for touch devices
Spread default of 180px gives a 360px wide pill area, which can overflow narrow phone screens unless spread is reduced
Injects a style tag with two keyframes
Window matchMedia listener for reduced motion is cleaned up on unmount, physics engine and animation frame are cleaned up on unmount
